newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa sold Schneider shares at 320.3 Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Axa sold Schneider shares at 320.3 Ffr.

text.p: Insurance group Axa-UAP said on Thursday it had sold 2.32 million Schneider shares at an average price of 320.30 francs a share.
It said it made a gross capital gain of 350 million francs on the sale of the shares.
The shares represented 1.67 percent of the total outstanding, leaving Axa with a 7.0 percent stake in Schneider, which it said it would keep.
It said it intended to hold on to the remaining 7.0 percent stake because it was covered by a shareholders' agreement.
The transaction will leave Axa with 9.9 percent of Schneider voting rights, down from 12.9 percent before the sale, it said.
The sale totaled 743 million francs, Axa said.
